data.displayName: Origin Affinity Variable Ongoing - My Connect

fees.description: A $117.54 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $52.20 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of up to $230.41 (GST Incl) may apply when your property is disconnected for non-payment. Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) may apply for each paper bill.

electricityContract.terms: Offer not available in all areas or properties connecting for first time. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 2.25 cents/kWh 50% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources
For 4.50 cents/kWh 100% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources

solarFeedInTariff.description: Origin offers 5 cents per kWh exported, subject to eligibility. All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges. You can find out more at www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges
